parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The data source. If this parameter is left empty, the image baseline policy is queried by default. Valid values:
- **default**: image
- **agentless**: agentless.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description: The ID of the baseline check policy.
